name: Arulmigu Maragathambigai Chandra Choodeswarar Temple
description: Historic 13th-century Hoysala/Chola hill temple situated atop a rocky outcrop in Hosur, dedicated to Lord Shiva as Chandra Choodeswarar and Goddess Maragathambigai. Offers panoramic views across Hosur city and Krishnagiri plains.

name: Ramanaicken Lake & Walking Promenade
description: Central municipal freshwater lake featuring an eco-walking track, landscaped children's play park, and urban bird-watching pavilion maintained by Hosur City Municipal Corporation.
address: Near Gandhi Statue, Lake Road, Hosur - 635109

name: Kelavarapalli Reservoir & Children's Park
description: Irrigation dam and scenic reservoir built across the Ponniyar (South Pennar) river located 10 km from Hosur city. Features landscaped green gardens and sunset viewpoints.
address: Kelavarapalli Dam Site, Moranapalli, Hosur Taluk - 635109

name: Rajaji Memorial (Thorapalli)
description: Birthplace and memorial ashram of Bharat Ratna C. Rajagopalachari (Rajaji), the last Governor-General of India and former Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu. Houses historical photographs, personal belongings, and a library.

name: Thally Hills & Floriculture Valley
description: Scenic plateau valley historically nicknamed 'Little England' for its pleasantly cool year-round climate, forested foothills, rose nurseries, and tranquil countryside.

name: Arulmigu Betrayaswamy Temple (Denkanikottai)
description: Ancient Vijayanagara-era temple dedicated to Lord Vishnu as Betrayaswamy, renowned for stone carving mandapams and the annual grand car festival (Brahmostavam).
